parameters.name: cluster
parameters.description: Name of the cluster running the schema. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: db
parameters.description: Name of the database running the schema.

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: The password used to authenticate with.

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: The username used to authenticate with. Default: "dbadmin"

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Database port to connect to. Default: "5433"

examples:
- name: Gathering vertica facts
  community.general.vertica_info: db=db_name
  register: result

- name: Print schemas
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ result.vertica_schemas }}"
